constraints.name: pos_cash_sessions_admin_closure_integrity_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((closing_mode IS NULL) OR ((status = 'closed'::text) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_by_admin_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_by_device_id IS NOT NULL) AND (closure_reason_code IS NOT NULL) AND (close_detail @> jsonb_build_object('closing_mode', closing_mode)) AND (close_detail ? 'expected_cash_total'::text) AND (((closing_mode = 'admin_audited'::text) AND (closing_counted_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (closing_counted_amount >= (0)::numeric) AND (cash_difference IS NOT NULL) AND (next_shift_fund >= (0)::numeric) AND (next_shift_fund <= closing_counted_amount) AND (reconciliation_status = ANY (ARRAY['verified'::text, 'verified_with_difference'::text]))) OR ((closing_mode = 'admin_unverified'::text) AND (closing_counted_amount IS NULL) AND (cash_difference IS NULL) AND (next_shift_fund = (0)::numeric) AND (reconciliation_status = 'unverified'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(audit_comments), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))))

constraints.name: pos_cash_sessions_amounts_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((opening_amount >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(opening_counted_amount, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(opening_suggested_amount, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(closing_counted_amount, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(next_shift_fund, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (cash_sales_total >= (0)::numeric) AND (customer_payments_total >= (0)::numeric) AND (cash_entries_total >= (0)::numeric) AND (cash_exits_total >= (0)::numeric) AND (expected_cash_total >= (0)::numeric)))
